items.title: Clinical evidence that the pandemic from 1889 to 1891 commonly called the Russian flu might have been an earlier coronavirus pandemic
items.note: Revisits published case descriptions and argues that a coronavirus deserves consideration.

items.title: The health and demographic impacts of the “Russian flu” pandemic in Switzerland in 1889/1890 and in the years thereafter
items.note: Uses Swiss death and population records to examine age, place and the timing of mortality.
